consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report - thermal exposure at SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on SG-3100 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 28 April 2012 a hazard report was recorded on SG-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
